title: Camera battery and memory card taken from locked locker

tellings.quote: And the battery is missing and the memory card is missing.

plain: A man named Michael Herrera, who says he saw a huge craft in the jungle of Indonesia, says that in 2009, aboard a ship at Subic Bay in the Philippines, he found that the battery and memory card were missing from his camera, even though it had been in a locked locker. He tells it because, if true, it would mean someone removed any pictures he might have taken.
